description: This file defines the OrderCriteria class used for specifying search or filter criteria related to orders in the e-commerce application. It extends the Criteria class and provides properties such as customerName, paymentMethod, and customerId with their respective getter and setter methods.

classes.name: OrderCriteria
classes.description: A Java class used to encapsulate various search parameters for orders within the application. Extends Criteria to inherit common filtering capabilities.

methods.name: setPaymentMethod
methods.description: Sets the payment method used for filtering orders.

methods.name: getPaymentMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the payment method used for filtering orders.

methods.name: setCustomerName
methods.description: Sets the customer's name for filtering orders.

methods.name: getCustomerName
methods.description: Retrieves the customer's name used for filtering orders.

methods.name: getCustomerId
methods.description: Retrieves the customer ID used for filtering orders.

methods.name: setCustomerId
methods.description: Sets the customer ID for filtering orders.
